zhDef: 1987 年 Rivest 设计的软件流密码，把短密钥「拉长」成伪随机密钥流；曾撑起 WEP、早期 TLS 与 WPA，却因密钥流重用和输出偏差频遭攻击，如今已被全面弃用。
enDef: A software stream cipher designed by Ron Rivest in 1987 that stretches a short key into a pseudorandom keystream. It powered WEP, early TLS and WPA, but keystream-reuse and bias attacks led to its complete deprecation.

zhDef: 2008 年 Bernstein 在 Salsa20 基础上改进的流密码，纯软件实现飞快、对硬件要求低；TLS 1.3 和 WireGuard 都把它列为默认加密，是当今流密码的当红明星。
enDef: A stream cipher designed by Daniel Bernstein in 2008 as an improved variant of his Salsa20. It is extremely fast in pure software and low-power, and is the default cipher in TLS 1.3 and WireGuard.

zhDef: 1994 年 NIST 标准化的签名算法，基于离散对数难题、由 ElGamal 签名演化而来；曾是政府与金融系统的标配，如今正被更小更快的 ECDSA 与 EdDSA 取代。
enDef: A US federal signature standard from 1994 built on the discrete logarithm problem and derived from ElGamal signatures. Long a government and finance staple, it is giving way to faster ECDSA and EdDSA.

zhDef: 1985 年 Taher ElGamal 提出：每次加密随机挑一个临时数，同一明文可生成不同密文，安全性基于离散对数难题；既能加密也能签名，启发了后来的一大批体制。
enDef: Proposed by Taher ElGamal in 1985: each encryption picks a fresh random value, so the same plaintext yields different ciphertexts. Based on the discrete logarithm problem, it supports both encryption and signatures.

zhDef: 1989 年 Claus Schnorr 提出的签名：短、快，还能把多人的签名线性合并成一把；因专利 2008 年才到期而长期被冷落，比特币 2021 年 Taproot 升级后正式采用。
enDef: A signature scheme by Claus Schnorr (1989) that is short, fast, and allows multiple signatures to be linearly combined into one. Blocked by patent until 2008, it was finally adopted by Bitcoin's 2021 Taproot upgrade.

zhDef: 每个明文块先与上一块密文异或再加密，让重复的明文块也产出不同的密文；需要不可预测的 IV、解密必须按顺序来，曾是使用最广的分组模式。
enDef: A block-cipher mode that XORs each plaintext block with the previous ciphertext block before encrypting, hiding repeating patterns. It needs an unpredictable IV, processes blocks in sequence, and was the classic default.

zhDef: 把递增的计数器加密后与明文异或，把分组密码变成流密码；各块完全独立、可并行处理，还能任意位置直接解密，流式传输与磁盘加密都爱它。
enDef: A mode that encrypts an incrementing counter and XORs it with plaintext, turning a block cipher into a stream cipher. Blocks are independent and parallelizable, and any position decrypts directly.

zhDef: CTR 加密与 Galois 域乘法认证的组合体，一次运算同时搞定机密性与完整性（AEAD）；TLS 1.2/1.3 的默认配置，现代互联网加密的标配。
enDef: An AEAD mode pairing CTR encryption with Galois-field multiplication for authentication, delivering confidentiality and integrity in one pass. It is the default choice in TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.

zhDef: 用共享密钥给消息算出的短校验标签，接收方重算比对即可发现任何篡改；它保证「消息没被动过」，但证明不了「是谁发的」。
enDef: A short tag computed from a message with a shared secret key; recomputing and comparing it reveals any tampering. It proves a message is unchanged, but not who sent it.

zhDef: 1996 年基于哈希函数（如 SHA-256）构造的 MAC，安全性几乎不依赖哈希的实现细节；TLS、JWT、API 签名里到处是它的身影。
enDef: A 1996 MAC built on top of a hash function such as SHA-256, whose security barely depends on the hash's implementation details. It appears everywhere: TLS, JWT, and API signing.

zhDef: 把弱口令、共享秘密或随机种子加工成合格密钥的工序，比如把「密码 + 盐」拉伸成 256 位 AES 密钥；熵不够的材料想变成密钥，全靠它把关。
enDef: A function that turns weak material—passwords, shared secrets, random seeds—into properly sized keys, e.g. stretching a password plus salt into a 256-bit AES key. It upgrades low-entropy input into usable key material.

zhDef: 1999 年基于 Blowfish 分组密码的慢速口令哈希，故意设计成「算得慢」并内置盐，把暴力破解拖到天荒地老；Unix 系系统与众多 Web 框架沿用至今。
enDef: A 1999 password hash built on the Blowfish cipher, deliberately slow and with built-in salting to stall brute force. It remains the default in many Unix systems and web frameworks.

zhDef: 2015 年密码哈希竞赛冠军，靠「吃内存 + 费 CPU」双重成本拖慢破解；主要变体有抗侧信道的 Argon2i 和通用推荐的 Argon2id。
enDef: Winner of the 2015 Password Hashing Competition; it forces attackers to pay in memory and CPU. Argon2i resists side channels, while Argon2id—the recommended default—combines both strengths.

zhDef: 输入任意数据、输出看似随机结果的函数，不知道密钥的人无法把它与真随机函数区分；HMAC 是标准例子，分组密码也常被当 PRF 用。
enDef: A function whose outputs look random to anyone without the key, indistinguishable from a truly random function. HMAC is the classic example, and block ciphers double as PRFs.

zhDef: 把一小段真随机种子「拉长」成大量看似随机的比特，流密码的密钥流就是这么来的；种子若不够随机，拉出来的全是伪随机。
enDef: A function that stretches a short truly random seed into a long stream of random-looking bits—exactly how stream-cipher keystreams are produced. If the seed is weak, everything downstream is weak.

zhDef: 最严苛的攻击模型：攻击者可以随时向解密预言机提问，还能根据上一次的回答调整下一次的提问（比只能预先提问的 CCA1 更强）；现代公钥加密必须在此模型下保持安全（IND-CCA2）。
enDef: The strictest attack model: the adversary queries a decryption oracle adaptively, choosing each ciphertext based on previous answers (stronger than the pre-query-only CCA1). Modern public-key encryption must be secure here (IND-CCA2).

zhDef: 不需要恢复密钥或明文，只要能把密文和纯随机串区分开，就算「破了一半」；现代安全证明几乎都以「攻击者无法区分」作为安全性的定义。
enDef: An attack that merely tells ciphertext apart from pure randomness, without recovering keys or plaintext—often enough to declare a scheme broken. Modern security proofs are phrased as indistinguishability.

zhDef: 让代码在秘密数据面前「面不改色」：无论密钥比特是什么，耗时都完全一致，从根上堵死计时攻击；这是 AES 等密码实现的基本功。
enDef: Writing code whose running time never depends on secret data, so timing reveals nothing about the key. It is the standard defense against timing attacks and a basic skill for crypto implementations.

zhDef: 服务器对「填充错误」和「认证失败」给出不同回应，这小小的差别就成了攻击者逐字节撬开密文的预言机；Vaudenay 2002 年把 Bleichenbacher 的思路用在 CBC 上，POODLE 等真实漏洞都是它的亲戚。
enDef: When a server answers padding errors and authentication failures differently, that tiny difference becomes an oracle letting an attacker decrypt byte by byte. Vaudenay applied Bleichenbacher's idea to CBC in 2002; real bugs like POODLE are descendants.

zhDef: 藏在算法或实现里的秘密入口（相当于藏在系统里的木马），设计者能借此绕过加密；最著名的当属 2013 年被曝的 Dual_EC_DRBG——一个被写进标准里的、带后门的伪随机数生成器。
enDef: A secret way to bypass a cryptosystem, hidden inside an algorithm or its implementation (the crypto equivalent of a trojan horse). The most notorious case is Dual_EC_DRBG, a standardized random generator revealed in 2013 to contain a backdoor.

zhDef: 把每一张 TLS 证书都公开记进只可追加的公共账本，谁也别想偷偷给你签一张假证书；浏览器会拒绝查不到日志记录的证书，让 CA 的滥权无所遁形。
enDef: A public, append-only ledger of every issued TLS certificate, so nobody can quietly mint a fake one. Browsers reject certificates missing from the logs, keeping certificate authorities honest.

zhDef: 浏览器实时向 CA 查询「这张证书吊销了吗」的协议，比下载整张吊销列表更快更省；缺点是要每次联网问、还泄露访问痕迹，如今常被 OCSP Stapling 替代。
enDef: A protocol for checking a certificate's revocation status in real time, faster and lighter than downloading a full revocation list. Its round-trip and privacy costs led to OCSP stapling.

zhDef: 网站通过响应头命令浏览器「以后只准用 HTTPS 访问我」，浏览器从此自动把 http 升级成 https，从源头掐断降级劫持；银行和邮箱都在靠它。
enDef: A response header ordering browsers to only ever contact the site over HTTPS, auto-upgrading http links and blocking downgrade attacks. Banks and email providers rely on it.

zhDef: 把数据块的哈希两两合并、层层向上，最终汇成单一根哈希；只要根哈希不变，任何叶子的篡改都会败露，比特币用它把整块交易压缩成一个根。
enDef: A structure that hashes data blocks pairwise up to a single root; any tampering with a leaf is caught at the root. Bitcoin uses it to compress a whole block of transactions into one root hash.

zhDef: 先完成一件「算起来难、验证起来秒过」的苦力活（比如暴力搜一个满足条件的哈希），才获得记账资格；比特币把出块成本变成攻击成本，中本聪 2008 年引入。
enDef: Requiring a costly but instantly verifiable computation—like searching for a hash with many leading zeros—before earning the right to append a block. Bitcoin (2008) turns that cost into the price of an attack.

zhDef: 只用哈希函数就能造的签名：Lamport 1979 年提出，私钥是一串秘密值、公开其哈希作公钥；不怕量子计算机，SPHINCS+ 已被 NIST 选入后量子标准。
enDef: Signatures built from hash functions alone: Lamport's 1979 scheme publishes hashes of secret values as the public key. Immune to quantum attacks, the hash-based SPHINCS+ was standardized by NIST for post-quantum use.

zhDef: 格密码的「镇山之宝」：给你一堆混着小噪声的线性方程，恢复其中的未知解极其困难，量子计算机也拿它没辙；NIST 选中的 Kyber 等后量子算法都建立在它之上。
enDef: The workhorse of lattice cryptography: recovering a secret from noisy linear equations is provably hard, even for quantum computers. NIST's post-quantum picks like Kyber rest on it.

zhDef: LWE 的多项式环版本：密钥更小、运算更快，让格密码从理论变成实用；代价是安全证明依赖环结构，NIST 的后量子标准 Kyber、Dilithium 都是它的模块化近亲。
enDef: The polynomial-ring version of LWE, with smaller keys and faster operations that make lattice crypto practical. Its proofs lean on ring structure; NIST's post-quantum standards Kyber and Dilithium are modular relatives.

zhDef: 1979 年 Shamir 的巧思：把一份秘密拆成 n 份，凑齐任意 k 份才能复原、少一份都不行；数学依据是「k 个点唯一确定一条 k-1 次多项式」，密码保险库和多签系统都在用。
enDef: Shamir's 1979 scheme splits a secret into n shares such that any k of them reconstruct it while fewer reveal nothing—thanks to the fact that k points define a unique degree k-1 polynomial. Used in vaults and multi-signature systems.

zhDef: 一群人里有人签了名，但没人知道具体是谁：签名用「一环」公钥生成，验证者只能确认签名者确实在环内；Monero 用它实现不可追踪的交易。
enDef: A signature generated with a 'ring' of public keys that proves the signer belongs to the set without revealing which one. Monero uses ring signatures to make transactions untraceable.
